rules.title: Standard Fillet Radii
rules.description: Standard fillet radii for tube corners based on thickness
rules.rule: Outer fillet radius: 2 * thickness, Inner fillet radius: thickness
rules.error_message: INFO: Standard fillet radii applied based on thickness: outer = 2 * thickness, inner = thickness.

rules.title: Outer Radius Adjustment
rules.description: If inner radius is not equal to thickness, calculate outer radius as inner radius + thickness
rules.rule: If inner_fillet_radius != thickness, then outer_fillet_radius = inner_fillet_radius + thickness
rules.error_message: INFO: Outer fillet radius adjusted to inner_fillet_radius + thickness since inner radius differs from thickness.

auto_determine.when: inner_fillet_radius != thickness and outer_fillet_radius is missing

rules.title: Max length of TUBE (ONLY MENTION WHEN USER ASKS, DON'T TREAT THIS AS A RULE)
rules.description: If the client asks for the maximum length of tubes. Answer: 5800 mm.

rules.title: Fishmouth on Tubes
rules.description: Critical information about fishmouth/wolf-mouth holes in tubes
rule: - **Fishmouth Definition**: When "fish-mouth / wolf-mouth" is mentioned, it refers to a hole.
- **Example**: fish-mouth Ø40 means a hole with diameter Ø40
- **Drilling Direction**: If not specified otherwise, drill only one side of the tube, not through to the opposite side

rules.title: Detailed Materials Information at TOLERY (ONLY MENTION WHEN USER ASKS, DON'T TREAT THIS AS A RULE)
rules.description: If the client asks for detailed information on materials at TOLERY, provide the link to the materials page.
rules.error_message: You will find detailed information at the following link: https://www.tolery.io/nos-matieres
